business_problem: Based in Mumbai, India, Dream11 brings Indian sports fans closer to the sports they love by providing world-class fan engagement and user experience through fantasy sports.
solution_summary: As an extremely popular global fantasy sports platform, Dream11 provides players with near-real-time updates and recommendations based on the statistics of real athletes. The management of its Elasticsearch clusters had become costly and complex, and engineers spent hours scaling manually to accommodate fluctuating data volumes. When Elasticsearch announced the sunsetting of its open-source distribution, Dream11 researched other options to power the search and analytics engine that is critical to its business. Dream11 chose to adopt a solution managed by Amazon Web Services (AWS) so that it could run and scale clusters without having to worry about managing, monitoring, and maintaining the infrastructure.

solution_components.name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
solution_components.role: Indexes content and powers search or analytics for the streaming analytics and reporting workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon EC2
solution_components.role: Provides scalable compute capacity for the streaming analytics and reporting workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS Graviton Processors
solution_components.role: Improves price-performance for the compute tier supporting the streaming analytics and reporting workflows.

data_flow: For example, Dream11 implemented Amazon EC2 instances powered by AWS Graviton Processors , designed by AWS to deliver the best price performance for cloud workloads running in Amazon EC2. Using AWS Graviton processor–based instances, Dream11 improved cluster performance by 40 percent while using 30 percent fewer nodes. Instead, they scale vertically, using the more powerful processors to distribute CPU utilization more uniformly among fewer machines.
business_outcome: To further enhance the internal user experience and generate analytics to drive business outcomes, Dream11 plans to implement additional features of OpenSearch.

evidence_quotes: Dream11 chose to adopt a solution managed by Amazon Web Services (AWS) so that it could run and scale clusters without having to worry about managing, monitoring, and maintaining the infrastructure.
It migrated to Amazon OpenSearch Service , an open-source, distributed search and analytics suite derived from Elasticsearch.

Working alongside AWS experts to fine-tune its compute infrastructure, Dream11 significantly optimized costs, boosted performance by 40 percent, and built an enhanced experience for its 200 million users.
It managed its own instances of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), which provides secure and resizable compute capacity for virtually any workload.

"We did our own research and found that Amazon OpenSearch Service was quite flexible, and its pricing was similar to the cost of managing our own OpenSearch machines on AWS," says Mehul Batra, software engineer at Dream11.
For the migration, Dream11 received support and guidance from AWS experts who helped optimize cluster configuration, performance, and security based on operational metrics and best practices.
